description:
The Shimano twist shifter makes gear changes easy and seamless, providing smooth transitions on any terrain. Paired with ergonomic grips, this design ensures comfort and control for an enjoyable and confident ride.
The wide, padded saddle offers superior comfort and support for long, relaxing rides. Its sleek brown finish adds a touch of elegance, ensuring both style and comfort come together perfectly.
The Shimano drivetrain delivers reliable performance and smooth gear changes, perfect for a comfortable ride. Combined with a durable chain guard and fenders, forget about snags and sprays.
The Shimano rear derailleur ensures smooth and accurate gear changes, giving you optimal control on any ride. Designed for performance and durability, it’s perfect for tackling hills, flat paths, and everything in between.
The clean, minimal design of the Sienna frame pairs classic style with modern elegance. Its sleek finish and sophisticated features make it a perfect choice for riders who value both aesthetics and performance in an everyday package.
